items.title: ICICI Bank profit spurts 20% on NII; core profitability a tad lower on FCNR(B)
items.description: ICICI Bank reported a 20% rise in second-quarter net profit, helped by an 18% increase in core net interest income. However, core profitability edged lower as FCNR(B) deposits weighed on margins. NIM fell to 4.18%, while treasury operations swung to a loss amid higher government bond yields.

items.title: HDFC Bank PAT ticks up 5% amid pressure
items.description: HDFC Bank reported a 4.7% rise in standalone net profit for the second quarter, while margin pressure weighed on core profitability. Net interest income rose 9.7% as loans and deposits grew. The lender is also set to welcome a new chief executive this month, ending prolonged succession uncertainty.

items.title: Ixigo Q2 profit jumps to 63 cr; revenue up 13%
items.description: Ixigo's financial report reveals a net profit of 63.42 crore for the July-September period, indicating robust performance. The company enjoyed a 13% increase in operational revenue, totaling 320.96 crore. Their hotel segment excelled with a Gross Bookings Value surpassing 100 crores, reflecting a remarkable 159% year-on-year growth and driving significant revenue increase, largely from its loyal user base utilizing various transportation services.

items.title: Axis Bank Q2 profit up 38% on loan growth
items.description: Axis Bank has showcased impressive results with a 38% surge in net profit for the quarter ending in September. This significant growth stems from strong loan demand and enhanced asset quality. The bank's net interest income increased by 11.8% year-on-year, totaling 15,371 crore, while overall advances rose by 23% compared to the previous year. The stability in the bank's net interest margin emphasizes its positive financial trajectory.

items.title: Central Bank of India’s Q2 profit jumps 21% YoY to Rs 1,469 crore
items.description: In September 2026, Central Bank of India reported an impressive net profit hike of 21%, totaling 1,469 crore. This boost was largely attributed to strong loan growth, even as other income declined. The bank's net interest income surged by 26% to 4,146 crore. Additionally, total income rose by 15% to reach 11,737 crore, with the cost-to-income ratio improving to 58.95% from 62.42% a year prior.

items.title: YES Bank Q2 profit rises 65%; AT1 hit may risk 5,217 cr loss
items.description: YES Bank's net profit increased by 65% to 1,080 crore in the second quarter, driven by higher income. However, factoring in a Supreme Court judgment could lead to a post-tax loss of 5,217 crore. The court upheld a ruling concerning the bank's AT1 bonds, impacting its financial reporting. The bank's auditors noted that the financial outcomes might have been significantly different without this recognition.

items.title: IDBI Bank Q2 net profit slides 39% to 2,205 crore
items.description: IDBI Bank witnessed a substantial 39% drop in net profit for the September quarter, primarily driven by decreased non-interest earnings. This follows a previous year where profits were significantly elevated by one-time gains. Nonetheless, net interest income saw a 29% increase year-on-year, indicating solid operational stability, although operating expenses surged by 19%. The bank's privatization, through the sale to Fairfax, aims to enhance performance and profitability.

items.title: Bajaj Finance Q2 preview: Profit may jump 29%, NII 24% as strong loan growth lifts earnings
items.description: Bajaj Finance is projecting a remarkable 29% increase in net profit for the July-September quarter, driven by robust loan demand and a boost in interest income. With a significant rise in assets under management, the demand for its lending products appears strong. Yet, analysts caution about potential pressure on lending margins owing to escalating borrowing costs.
